sentences.text: 2. I.A.No.1 of 2025 is filed by the 2nd respondent/de-facto complainant to accord permission to compound the offence in FIR.No.541 of 2023 on the file of Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur district.
3. I.A.No.2 of 2025 is filed by the 2nd respondent/de-facto complainant to accord permission to record the compromise between the accused Nos.2 to 4 and the de-facto complainant.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing respondent No.1/State as well as learned counsel for the respondent No.2 are present.
6. Today, when the matter is taken up, petitioners and respondent No.2 are present before this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for respondent No.2 have identified the parties in the open Court.
7. This Court has questioned the respondent No.2 with regard to compromise, and she categorically stated to that extent that she has voluntarily entered into compromise with the petitioners herein.
This Court is satisfied with the identification of the parties and voluntariness in arriving at the compromise.
The demand draft of Rs.15,00,000/- was handed over before this Court.

8. Since the parties entered into settlement, the Criminal Petition is allowed and therefore, the proceedings in FIR.No.541 of 2023 on the file of Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur district, against the petitioners herein is hereby quashed.
9. Accordingly, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025 and Criminal Petition No.6676 of 2023 are allowed.
10. As a sequel, Interlocutory Applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_ _ _ _____________ JUSTICE HARINATH.N Date : 08.05.2025 BMS Bitra Chakradhar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175431555/
